description: mq-bridge async message-bridging library run as an HTTP server. A single catch-all http->response route dispatches on request metadata and replies through mq-bridge's inline-response fast path; hyper-util's auto connection builder serves HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 prior-knowledge (h2c) on the cleartext port. Postgres via sqlx for async-db, dataset read from /data/dataset.json, static assets from /data/static, gzip negotiated by the library's response compression.
